meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin under ₹700 in India, the best serum choice depends on whether your main concern is **active breakouts/clogged pores** (best treated with Salicylic Acid) or **oil control and fading post-acne marks** (best treated with Niacinamide).[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/blogs/skin-care/top-face-serum-for-acne-prone-skin-in-2026#:~:text=Its%20effectiveness%20comes%20from%202%25%20salicylic%20acid,for%2030ml.%20Rating%3A%204.8%2F5%20on%20official%20website.)

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum targets **blackheads and whiteheads** with exfoliating **2% salicylic acid**, helping to clear congestion and control excess oil.

The Minimalist 10% Niacinamide Serum with Zinc uses **10% niacinamide and zinc** to **fade acne marks**, calm redness, and balance sebum production without exfoliating acids.

The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a **cult-favourite lightweight formula** that regulates sebum, improves skin texture, and minimizes the look of pores.

The Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Face Serum with Azelaic Acid combines **12% niacinamide and azelaic acid** to calm active breakouts, reduce redness, and target stubborn pigmentation.

The Chemist at Play 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum Treats Acne features **salicylic acid and zinc PCA** alongside ceramides to deeply unclog pores while **protecting the moisture barrier**.

The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Serum for Active Acne is a targeted treatment designed to **exfoliate dead skin cells**, clear active blemishes, and prevent future breakouts.
